data.description:
## Description

**What**: Run .claude/scripts/dso validate.sh --ci and full plugin test suite; confirm all tests pass after the sweep.

**Why**: SC-6 requires all existing tests to pass — sweep must not regress any behavior.

**Scope**: Run validate.sh --ci, capture output; classify any failures as pre-existing (failed on main before epic) vs sweep-introduced; sweep-introduced failures route to /dso:fix-bug; pre-existing failures documented with commit SHA proving pre-existing status.

## Acceptance Criteria

- .claude/scripts/dso validate.sh --ci exits 0, OR every non-zero failure documented as pre-existing with a commit SHA from main showing pre-existing status
- Plugin test suite (test-batched.sh across bash/node/pytest runners) reports no sweep-introduced failures
- docs/findings/epic-5018-64ce-todo-sweep.md has final 'Validation' section with validate.sh exit code and per-runner test counts
- Any sweep-introduced failure has a corresponding bug ticket filed and linked
data.title: UPDATE: Final validation — full plugin test suite passes after sweep
